chunks: A group narrated to me on the authority of Abul Hasan Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawood al-Qummi and Ibn Quluwayh (from his father) from Saad ibn Abdullah, who said: The Veracious Shaykh Ahmad ibn Ishaq ibn Saad al-Ash'ari (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, and he mentioned the hadith which we mentioned earlier.

key_terms.الصَّدُوقُ: The Veracious (a title for Ahmad ibn Ishaq)

ai.seo_question: Who are the narrators in this chain from Al-Ghayba?
ai.summary: This isnad from Al-Ghayba highlights the scholarly transmission of the Imam's directives during the Minor Occultation, specifically linking the prominent jurist al-Shaykh al-Saduq to the broader network of Qum and Rayy scholars. It underscores the reliability of the chain by citing well-known authorities like Ibn Qulawayh and al-Tabari, reinforcing the authenticity of the reported hadith within Shia tradition.
